title: Page 388
transc:
Ft Monroe Mar 15 / 65
J. H. Emerick Hdqrs. A. J. 
Farmer for Mentor unity oyster sharons can go to
Genoa pacific can land at several vernons on the 
Nancy moaned Shannons are not tarquin to cover them
any where on the Nancy moaned if intended to
plum the Black water any where near Franklin or
waxy Quay villages or a flat or raft are
tarquin a man named Boyle who always accompanies romans
in that direction is now at blubber a contract
to get out welch ties zebra I will not
come up until whelp and will leave word where
the landing should be for sumners panama if I
am not here to direct unity I am sure
that any where near the direction of Not to
way weldon patent from Georgia boats are tarquin to
pocket the windpipe zodiac on the upper black water
and upper not to way plumings might be effected
without viennas zebra paradise Lewis has about person prolong
panama zodiac That is all I have this side
the Bergen zebra Boyle knows all the ruffles sligo
windsor zebra I have sent for him and if
he is not at Black I will send up
further sweden if it differs from what I have
sent star but I am sure I am right
unity The windsor is about feeble publish yards wide
at waxend Quay walrus George H Gordon palsy finis
Geo D. Sheldon
